negative_findings.description: No confirmed POS-terminal series for North Macedonia was located inside the IMF FAS results surfaced by search; only ATM-per-100,000-adults values for MK were visible. FAS documentation states POS terminals were added as a newer access-point indicator, but MK reporting of it is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM density for MK found via FAS/World Bank/FRED; MK POS density not confirmed at the supranational layer.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: POS terminal density is a core A4 metric; if FAS does not carry MK POS data, the national central bank payment statistics become the only source and the international benchmark cannot be built.

negative_findings.description: Supranational and donor bodies in this cell (IMF, World Bank, EBRD, CEB, TED, OECD-style benchmarks) publish essentially only in English for North Macedonia; Macedonian-language material found was national-government mirroring of EU documents (MEP, Ministry of Finance, MDT portal) rather than donor-original publication.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian-language queries returned government mirrors and media coverage, not donor primary sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Macedonian-language monitoring of this cell should target government EU-integration portals rather than the donors themselves; searching donor sites in mk will keep returning nothing.

negative_findings.description: The CEB country page URL for North Macedonia and the current EBRD PSD search URL were inferred from site navigation patterns rather than observed directly; EBRD restructured its website and legacy PSD/SolrSearch URLs appear to redirect.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both entries recorded with reduced confidence; treat as hypotheses for the liveness pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector hard-coding these paths may 404; the discovery pass should resolve them from the site root instead.

negative_findings.description: No donor-funded project dedicated specifically to card/ATM/POS acceptance infrastructure in North Macedonia was identified. Donor digitalisation money found is directed at SME digital technology on-lending (EBRD Go Digital), public administration and PFM IT (IPA), and the digital economy broadly (World Bank NODE).
negative_findings.result_summary: Payment-acceptance infrastructure is not an explicit donor line item in the material found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts should not expect a donor project register to describe the acceptance market directly; the donor layer is mainly useful for benchmarks, conditionality (SEPA) and adjacent IT tenders.

coverage_gaps.description: Several plausible supranational actors in this cell were not searched in this pass: EIB / EIB Global, BIS (CPMI Red Book and statistics, likely non-member so probably absent), UNCDF, USAID/SIDA/SECO bilateral donors, the Western Balkans Investment Framework (WBIF) project pipeline, and the Vienna Initiative / EFSE and Green for Growth funds.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second pass over WBIF (wbif.eu) project pipeline, EIB project register, EFSE and the Vienna Initiative reports filtered on North Macedonia.

coverage_gaps.description: It was not established whether Findex 2025 country-level microdata for MK is openly downloadable or requires a licensed-access request, nor whether the MK sample supports card/POS-level breakdowns.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Open the MK microdata catalogue entry and read the access policy and questionnaire before planning collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage (a significant official language in MK) was entirely outside the run's declared language set and was not attempted for donor/EU material.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If the run scope ever widens, add sq-language queries against EU delegation and government EU-integration portals.

coverage_gaps.description: The concrete machine-access paths for IMF FAS (post-migration data.imf.org SDMX endpoints) and for the TED search API were not tested, only inferred.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prototype one SDMX call for MKD FAS indicators and one TED API query with a MK country filter to confirm parameters before building collectors.

brief: The supranational and donor layer is the strongest English-language backbone for North Macedonia payments intelligence: IMF FAS supplies the supply-side ATM (and possibly POS) density series, World Bank Findex 2025 supplies the demand-side account/card/digital-payment behaviour, and IMF Article IV plus the EC Enlargement Package supply annual independent narrative on the banking and payment-system reform trajectory. The donor money layer - EU IPA and the Reform and Growth Facility, EBRD Go Digital credit lines to Sparkasse and NLB Banka Skopje, World Bank digital-economy and financial-sector operations - is documented through TED procurement notices, EU Funding & Tenders prospects and IFI project registers, all of which are machine-collectable and reveal vendors, budgets and system scope. Almost nothing in this layer is published in Macedonian; local-language monitoring must instead target the government mirrors (mep.gov.mk, finance.gov.mk, mdt.gov.mk) that republish EC reports and Reform Agenda milestones such as SEPA accession. The main open risks are whether MK actually reports POS terminals to FAS and whether Findex MK microdata is openly downloadable - both should be resolved before collectors are built.
